occurrence_sentence: Fujitsu is deploying its [AI Test Drive Lab](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fujitsu.com%2Fglobal%2Fproducts%2Fdata-transformation%2Fdata-driven%2Fai-test-drive%2F&esheet=53563136&newsitemid=20230927422402&lan=en-US&anchor=AI+Test+Drive+Lab&index=3&md5=2206dcd557b144e65b337bc3c7e838ec) in Cyxtera's COE in the U.K., providing direct access to Fujitsu infrastructure and solutions, technology from partners like NVIDIA, Intel, and SUSE, and consultancy services needed to develop and validate AI theories and models.
